decisions.reason: The sourced wall-top stone does not match the ordinary NGSL cope verb. The original masonry explanation is a homonym mismatch; a figurative achievement sense must not be silently substituted.
The carbon-related or carbon-yielding definition is a precise chemistry meaning. Restrict to Academic and do not present it as equivalent to every use of organic.
WordNet clearly defines a malignant epithelial-tissue tumor, an appropriate Academic biology extension of cancer. No diagnostic, prognosis or treatment guidance is included.
The checked sources yielded no exact factual candidate for this material. Preserve the model's proposed paper explanation hidden until a definition is attributable.
The sourced meanings concern gas-relieving medication/substances. The generic Fitness digestive anchor does not establish an appropriate medication-learning context; avoid importing treatment claims.
The group of wrist bones is an explicit, directly relevant anatomical meaning. It does not claim the bone group is identical to every aspect of the wrist joint.
The collapsed phrase lacks exact evidence and its vehicle-wheel meaning conflicts with Fitness cartwheel gymnastics. Keep both identity and topic concerns hidden.
A cartel member or supporter is a clear Business meaning relevant to collective market control. Do not equate each member with an individual monopolist.
The candidate connects salts to milk-protein coagulation in a way that needs clearer chemical evidence. Do not publish the model's broad processed-commercial-casein equivalence.
The terse uncoagulated-casein definition conflicts with the proposed precursor framing and lacks historical/technical context. Keep the precise milk-protein identity uncertain.
The only definition repeats castigates without explaining the criticism. No self-contained factual explanation was found locally.
A rejected or discarded thing is explained directly and fits discard. No requirement that it is passed to another person is added.
The candidates repeat catabolism or say destructive metabolism, which risks misleading learners about the neutral breakdown process. A clearer source definition is required.
The general candidate is circular and the complete alternative means a catalytic converter, not an enzyme. Do not substitute the vehicle component into biology vocabulary.

WordNet supports any tail-like structure, fitting technical anatomical terminology. Restrict to Academic and do not impose the unsupported vertebrate-only limitation or select the unrelated diacritic.
The waterproof filler/sealant for building and repair is self-contained and fits sealing joints. Slang sleep/sexual senses and unsupported paintability claims are excluded.
The only candidate says in a censorious manner without a standalone disapproval meaning. The earlier model's moral/authoritative description is not factual source text.
The Mexico-specific hundredth-of-a-peso meaning is clear monetary vocabulary. Do not publish the broader historical country list as if every listed currency currently uses this unit.
The central body of a vertebra is explicitly described and fits Fitness spinal anatomy. The generic centre, cranial and earthquake senses are excluded.
The anterior brain portion consisting of two hemispheres is a concise sourced anatomical meaning. Restrict the technical term to Academic; do not imply it means the entire brain.
The judge's private-office meaning matches the legal office context. Preserve plural usage and the source's in-chambers wording; ignore the unrelated proper-name WordNet entry.
The small folded book containing poems, ballads or tracts fits booklet/publishing vocabulary. Do not add self-publication as a necessary feature.
The bright yellowish-green adjective directly matches the color anchor. Liqueur, pottery and food meanings are not selected.
Rebuke/punishment supplies a standalone explanation in the definition and fits penalty. Do not imply endorsement of physical punishment or a required parent-child setting.
The combination of chemotherapy and radiotherapy is explicit Academic medical terminology. Unlike the old gloss, it does not require simultaneous administration or offer treatment advice.
The source explains a sensory organ/cell responding to a chemical stimulus, with taste/smell context. This is a precise biology extension of receptor.
The specified padded sofa with arms/back at the same height fits furnishings. Exclude the statesman, overcoat and regional any-sofa senses, and do not add an unverified luxury requirement.
Nerve/chromatid crossings do not establish relevance to a Fitness crossover movement. The existing biological crossover proposal is a topic mismatch.
WordNet defines the gum-like sapodilla substance, fitting chewing-gum material vocabulary. Avoid treating the older principal-ingredient claim as universal modern manufacturing practice.
The refrigeration machine removing heat from working fluid is a complete technical meaning related to cooler. Frightening films and the less precise cold-air machine wording are not selected.
The source explains a winged mammal of Chiroptera and explicitly identifies a bat. Restrict taxonomy to Academic; exclude the Fitness equipment homonym.

The restaurant specializing in chops/steaks is clear dining vocabulary. Preserve the source's historical label rather than silently presenting every use as contemporary; exclude Nigerian general-restaurant and Chinese customs senses.
The candidate descriptions mix double-helix strands, chromosome splitting and cell-division stages. Keep hidden until a clearer source distinguishes the chromosome copy from a DNA strand.
The nuclear DNA/RNA/protein complex is a self-contained Academic biology meaning. Do not inherit the narrower assertion that the word applies only to an uncondensed functional state.
No exact factual candidate was extracted for this participle. The recorded-events meaning cannot simply be equated with the adjective historical.
The ankle-height shoe laced through two or three pairs of eyelets resolves the circular chukka-boot candidate and matches footwear. The polo-period homonym is excluded.
The source explicitly defines cigarette and marks it informal. Retain the register warning; publishing a lexical abbreviation does not endorse tobacco use.
The girdle/belt and architectural-band meanings do not match the Fitness body-waistline anchor. Keep this clothing/body distinction unresolved rather than calling it a sophisticated synonym.
Five-pip game pieces or the number five do not fit the ordinary Academic fin anchor. The old game-of-chance homonym connection is not an appropriate learning expansion.
The only candidate repeats circuitous twice and provides no independent explanation. The model's roundabout-path description remains unverified.
Limiting narrowly/restricting is clear and fits the abstract scope/authority context. Geometry and literal encircling senses are not mixed into this approval.
Considering all relevant facts and circumstances provides the explicit cautious-deliberation meaning. It does not turn the noun into an interchangeable adjective for alert.
The hereditary-material unit encoding one protein is a precise molecular-biology definition. Restrict to Academic instead of treating it as a universal everyday synonym of gene.
The state of being a citizen is explained directly and matches citizenship. Exclude the collective all-citizens sense and unsupported comparative formality claims.
An individual act/expression of polite behavior matches the courtesy-gesture anchor. Preserve the countability/plural labels rather than mixing it with the general politeness quality.
